designTimeFinding.what: The Williamson crosswalk (a disjoint copy of parcel-record-fill.mjs's WILLIAMSON_CROSSWALK_SQL, carrying tax_year through) re-scanned cad_property's full numeric roll on every page. A local dry-run against live Williamson data (282,570 parcels) did not complete in 5+ minutes.
designTimeFinding.fix: Applied the zone-major lesson from this seat's own PARCEL-R4-COMPANIONS card (paid for live, earlier this same session) before shipping, not after a live failure: the numeric roll is materialized once per county into a session TEMP table with its own index (HOIST_NUMERIC_ROLL_SQL) before the page loop, and the page-scoped crosswalk query joins against that.
designTimeFinding.measuredImprovement: Williamson dry-run: did not complete in 5+ minutes (unbatched-per-page join) -> 66 seconds (materialized once).

pilot.preExistingInfrastructureChecked: cad_property_vintage_crosswalk / cad_property_vintage_fallback: live schema, clearly purpose-built for this exact cross-vintage identity problem (from_prop_id/to_prop_id across tax years, with a fallback table). Checked before designing anything -- populated ONLY for counties 48113 and 48439, zero rows for any of this program's six counties. Not usable; not touched; not repurposed.

verification.independentSQL_williamsonCrosswalk: A freshly-authored TEMP table + indexed join (separate from this job's own code), run live: CREATE TEMP TABLE verify_numeric AS SELECT prop_id, situs_address, tax_year, market_value FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips='48491' AND prop_id ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND situs_address IS NOT NULL; ... WITH target AS (...) joined AS (... JOIN verify_numeric ...) ranked AS (... count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY target_prop_id, tax_year) ...) SELECT count(DISTINCT target_prop_id) WHERE match_count=1 -> 257,604. This is an EXACT match to PARCEL-R1B-REINGEST's own documented figure ('257,604 of 282,569 R-prefix accounts, 91.2%'), confirming this job's crosswalk logic reproduces R1B's proven mechanism, not merely resembles it.

postApplyStoreVerification.queryingRule: cell_state joined to parcel_record on county_fips (indexed), not a place_key string split -- the store timed out at 50s under concurrent load from other lanes and succeeded at 90s, per this store's own established timeout-under-load doctrine.
